title: Verified TLS by default
statement: The store this component emits MUST require verified TLS for its database connection, and MUST NOT fall back to plaintext or to unverified TLS.

title: Weak transport modes are refused
statement: The store this component emits MUST refuse the sslmode values disable, allow, prefer, require and verify-ca.

title: The loopback exception is narrow
statement: The store this component emits MUST permit plaintext only to a literal loopback address and only while the explicit test setting is 1, and MUST refuse a DNS name, a Unix socket, a remote host, a host list and any other value of that setting.

title: The chain, the name and the version are checked
statement: The store this component emits MUST check the certificate chain and the server name, and MUST require TLS 1.2 or later.
